findings.current: He was the one who had sent me the New Year’s Day invitation.
findings.defect: This changes the action from Jin Wikyung sending Taekyung out carrying the invitation to merely sending the invitation to Taekyung.
findings.rationale: The construction 내게 … 들려 보낸 means that Jin Wikyung sent the narrator with the invitation in hand, which also explains why his prior contact with Lee Seowol did not surprise him.
findings.replacement: He was the one who had sent me to deliver the New Year’s Day invitation.
findings.source: 바로 그가 내게 원단 초대장을 들려 보낸 장본인이니까.

findings.current: A tremendous roar erupted from the martial artists of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.defect: The draft limits the roar to the Jin martial artists, while the source says the roar erupted with them at its center, indicating participation spreading beyond them.
findings.rationale: 중심으로 identifies the Jin martial artists as the center of the response, not its sole participants.
findings.replacement: A tremendous roar erupted from the crowd, centered on the martial artists of the Jin Family of Taiyuan.
findings.source: 태원진가의 무인들을 중심으로 거대한 함성이 터져 나왔다.

findings.current: Even when the branches and leaves broke and fell, the roots remained whole.
findings.defect: The draft applies both actions indiscriminately to the branches and leaves, blurring the source’s paired image of branches breaking and leaves falling.
findings.rationale: The coordinated Korean verbs preserve distinct physical actions for the branches and leaves.
findings.replacement: Even when the branches broke and the leaves fell, the roots remained whole.
findings.source: 가지와 잎이 꺾이고 떨어져도 뿌리는 온전했다.

findings.current: The two eyes pouring out flames swept across the crowd.
findings.defect: “The two eyes pouring out flames” is an unnatural anatomical calque that distracts from the intended image.
findings.rationale: The source depicts Jin Wikyung’s fiercely burning gaze; “blazing eyes” conveys that image naturally without changing the action.
findings.replacement: His blazing eyes swept across the crowd.
findings.source: 화염을 쏟아 내는 두 개의 눈동자가 좌중을 쓸어 보았다.

findings.current: The moment the Jin Family of Taiyuan accepted the Mount Heng Sword Sect as family retainers.
findings.defect: The plural “family retainers” treats the sect as a collection of household personnel rather than preserving its collective political subordination as a vassal organization.
findings.rationale: 가신 here defines the entire Mount Heng Sword Sect’s new subordinate relationship to the Jin Family, a meaningful change in hierarchy.
findings.replacement: The moment the Jin Family of Taiyuan accepted the Mount Heng Sword Sect as its vassal.
findings.source: 원단 첫날. 태원진가가 항산검문을 가신(家臣)으로 받아들이는 순간이었다.

findings.current: For some reason, something seemed to be poking at me.
findings.defect: The literal wording is unnatural and obscures the figurative pang prompted by Chulwoo’s plans resembling Taekyung’s own past behavior.
findings.rationale: 쿡쿡 찔리다 figuratively conveys a recurring inward prick or pang here, not an unidentified object physically poking him.
findings.replacement: For some reason, I felt a strange pang.
findings.source: 왠지 모르게 어디가 쿡쿡 찔리는 것 같기도 하고.

findings.current: Chulwoo raised his fist, then stopped short.
findings.defect: The draft states that Chulwoo raised his fist, while the source says he was about to do so before stopping.
findings.rationale: 추어올리려던 marks an intended, imminent action interrupted by his awareness of Baek Museong, not a completed raising of the fist.
findings.replacement: Chulwoo was about to raise his fist when he stopped short.

summary: The draft contains one critical action error, two meaningful hierarchy or participation errors, and several localized fidelity and prose issues.
